title: Causal Self-Attention
hint: Same as softmax attention but mask future positions with -inf before softmax. torch.triu(..., diagonal=1) gives the upper triangle.

description.text: Implement causal (masked) self-attention for autoregressive models: each position may attend only to itself and previous positions (GPT-style). Apply an additive mask before softmax so future positions contribute zero probability mass.

constraints: Use PyTorch only unless task says otherwise.
